Author: Ravindra Maithani

High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No. 1691 of 2023

 Versus

Present:-
 Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for the applicant through video
 conferencing.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. M.K. Chand, A.G.A. for the State.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant Shahadat is in judicial custody in Fir No.44 of 2023, under Sections 376 Ab, 376 (2)(f)
Ipc and Section 5(m)(n)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police
Station- Piran Kaliyar, District- Haridwar.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant is the father of the victim.
On 30.01.2023, when the victim was all alone in the house, the applicant did Galat Kaam with her.
The informant, who happens to be the mother of the victim, was told about it by the victim.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim, her mother and other witnesses have not supported the prosecution case at trial.
5. Learned State Counsel would submit that the Forensic Report detects semen on the garments of the victim.
6. It is the stage of bail.
Much of the discussion at this stage is not expected of.

To the extent of appreciating the controversy, the matter may be examined with the caveat that any observation,
made at this stage, shall have no bearing at any subsequent stage of the case.
7. The medical report is on record.

According to the statement, which the victim gave to the Doctor,
the applicant had touched his penis in the vagina of the victim.
She had not told about the complete act.
If it is so, how could semen be on the clothes of the victim?
As stated, the victim and other witnesses have not supported the prosecution case at the trial.

sentences.text: Without adverting much to the merits,, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
9. The bail application is allowed.
10. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned.
